name: capture-two-places
story: Type a mixed thought with a task and a question, press Capture, and show the resulting Action and Thread appear on the board — one sentence, two places.

name: mark-done
story: Capture 'send Maya the revised contract today,' open the resulting Action, press Mark done, and show it fade from the open list.

name: distill-messy
story: Enter a long rambling thought in the capture field, choose Distill instead of capture, show the distilled wording, then accept it onto the board.
note: Distill requires a model API key (GROQ, Mistral, OpenRouter, etc.) — none is configured. The [aria-label="Distilled wording"] element never appears; times out at 60s.

name: shelf-life
story: Capture 'renew the domain,' open its Action, use Change shelf life to set when it matters, then return to the board with the dated action visible.

name: search-thought
story: Capture a note about pricing strategy, use Search everything for 'pricing,' and open the matching Thread from the results.
